sourceCard.name: Sandık Çantası
sourceCard.text: Savaşta yok olmaz. Her Hazırlık Aşaması’nda OP −200.
sourceCard.textEn: Cannot be destroyed in battle. Lose 200 OP during every Standby Phase.

semanticRelation: A serviceable ballot bag with worn canvas, repaired carrying straps and blank envelopes suggests durability maintained at a continuing cost. No new equipment, reward, coin, stat icon or literal payoff is depicted. Exact battle protection and standby cost remain unchanged outside the illustration.
geometry: Independently authored rounded cloth volume with actual low-frequency folds, front pocket, stitched rim, two leather straps, hollow buckles and raised handle loops; three rotated envelope solids; timber table and wall.
lighting: One deterministic sampled area emitter; per-sample shadow ray intersections; diffuse plus GGX direct response; one traced specular reflection from timber/metal; no painted light plates.
limitations: One primary sample per pixel, not converged Monte Carlo path tracing.
Procedural weave and folds are mathematical approximations, not fabric simulation.
576x384 is the canonical art aspect only; actual DOM crop was not verified.
No production, offline, engine, save, package or dependency changes.
